parameters.name: DefenseType
parameters.description:
The type of the protection rule. Only the following value is supported:
- **global**: a global-level rule.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token (**Token**) for the next page. If a next page exists, this field has a return value.

> If this parameter has a return value, a next page exists. Use the returned **NextToken** as a request parameter to obtain the data on the next page. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the rule to query.
